title: My Space
description: Everything that defines your space: name, contacts, operating hours, billing and invoices.

aiSuggestion.publicBookingNoContact: Public booking is on but no phone, email or Telegram is on file — anyone who books won't know how to reach you.
aiSuggestion.billingEmpty: Your billing identity is empty — add a legal name before you generate the first invoice.
aiSuggestion.taxIdMissing: Company / Reg ID is missing. Most jurisdictions need it on every invoice you issue.
aiSuggestion.noContact: No contact method on file yet. Add a phone, email or Telegram so prospects and members can reach you.
aiSuggestion.noLogo: No logo on file — adding one brands your invoices and the public booking page.
aiSuggestion.noWorkingDays: No working days picked — the calendar can't open for bookings.

general.title: General
general.description: Your space name, timezone and visual identity.
general.nameHelp: Shown on invoices, the public booking page, and the calendar.
general.timezoneHelp: Used for booking windows, invoices, and email timestamps.
general.languagesHelp: Languages available for your space. When multiple languages are enabled, a language switcher appears on your public booking page and across the space.

operatingHours.title: Operating hours
operatingHours.description: Working days, booking hours and closure dates. Closed days block bookings and smart-lock entry.
operatingHours.workingDaysHelp: Used as the default schedule before you set more detailed hours below.
operatingHours.orgDefaultHelp: This is the org-wide default. Meeting rooms can still override it per room in Rooms settings.

closureDates.label: Closure dates
closureDates.help: These days are closed for desk and meeting-room bookings (operator calendar, public page, and member booking).
closureDates.rangeHint: Leave the second date empty to close a single day. Both ends are included.
closureDates.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
closureDates.maxDaysClosure: Close at most {{max}} days at a time.
closureDates.singleDateAlreadyListed: That date is already a closure day.
closureDates.rangeAlreadyListed: Every date in that range is already a closure day.
closureDates.existingBookingsDesc: {{total}} booking(s) already exist {{scope}} ({{deskCount}} desk, {{roomCount}} meeting room). Adding the closure blocks new bookings but does not cancel existing ones.
closureDates.existingBookingsRetained: Existing bookings were left in place — review or cancel them manually.

contact.title: Contacts & Space
contact.description: How members and prospects reach you — shown on your public booking page and shared links.
contact.websiteHelp: Shown on your public booking page; also shared by the AI concierge when visitors want more detail.

billing.title: Billing & invoices
billing.description: How you recognize revenue, your default currency, and how invoice numbers are generated.
billing.revenueHelp: By payment recognises revenue when money arrives. By services delivered recognises it on the booked service date.
billing.invoiceDetailsDesc: Seller details printed on every invoice you generate.
billing.bankDetailsHelp: Printed at the bottom of the invoice. Plain text is fine.
billing.vatRateHelp: Applied to new invoices. Use 0 if you don't charge VAT.
billing.pricesIncludeVatHelp: On: visitors pay the listed price (VAT is already inside it). Off: listed prices are net and VAT is added at checkout and on invoices.
billing.nextInvoiceNumberHelp: Auto-incremented each time you generate an invoice.
billing.prefixHelp: Printed before the number. Insert the year/month of the issue date with the chips above.
billing.zeroPaddingHelp: Digits the number is padded to, e.g. {{example}}.
billing.zeroPaddingInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.

invoiceLabels.title: Invoice labels
invoiceLabels.cardDesc: Customize PDF labels for local language or accounting wording.
invoiceLabels.dialogDesc: Overrides only affect newly rendered invoice PDFs. Empty fields use the English default.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.exportDesc: Download a ZIP of all bookings, members, and invoices. Useful before any destructive action.
dangerZone.transferDesc: Hand <1>{{name}}</1> over to another team member. They'll have full admin rights.
dangerZone.deleteDesc: Permanently delete <1>{{name}}</1>, all bookings, members, and history. There's a 30-day grace period — after that it's gone.
dangerZone.comingSoonDesc: Reach out at hello@ohmydesk.app and we'll handle it for you in the meantime.

team.title: Team
team.descGroup: Managers have access to all locations in your group.
team.descSingle: Invite managers to help run your space. Max 3 team members.
team.inviteDescGroup: We'll create an account and give them access to all locations.
team.inviteDescSingle: We'll create an account and send them login credentials.
team.validEmailRequired: Please enter a valid email address
team.managerAddedNoEmailDesc: Account created{{locationNote}} but email failed to send. Share the credentials manually.

legacyOrgPage.title: Organization

orgCard.title: Organization
orgCard.slugImmutable: Slug cannot be changed after creation.
orgCard.workingDaysHelp: Select which days your space is open for bookings.
orgCard.openHoursHelp: Window visitors can book meeting rooms in. From {{open}} to {{close}}.
orgCard.hoursInvalid: Open hour must be before close hour.

legacyOrgPage.contactNonAdmin: Ask a space owner or admin to manage contact info.
legacyOrgPage.billingCardDesc: Seller details and invoice numbering. Shown on every invoice you generate.
legacyOrgPage.bankPlaceholderMultiline:
Bank Name
BIC: ABCDEFGH
IBAN: XX00 0000 0000 0000 0000 00
legacyOrgPage.molHelp: Name of the person who signs invoices on behalf of the company.
legacyOrgPage.nextInvoicePreview: Next invoice will be issued as {{number}}.
legacyOrgPage.migrateNumberingHelp: Moving from another system? Set Next invoice # to the number you want to continue from (e.g. 400326) and set zero-padding to match your old format — your sequence carries on unbroken.
legacyOrgPage.draftSkipped: {{count}} skipped. Digest email sent to owner{{extra}}.
legacyOrgPage.nothingToInvoice: Nothing to invoice — no opted-in members yet.

logo.title: Logo
logo.help: Shown on the public booking page.
logo.invalidTypeDesc: Please upload a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or SVG image.
logo.uploadedDesc: Your space logo has been updated.

autoInvoicing.title: Auto-invoicing
autoInvoicing.scheduleHelp: Controls the existing scheduled invoice run. Off disables the monthly cron for this space.
autoInvoicing.firstDayOfPeriod: On the first day of the new period
autoInvoicing.prepareHelp: Controls how early the recurring-cycle ledger opens the next period's charge. Invoice drafts still follow the monthly schedule above.
autoInvoicing.runNowHelp: Runs the same invoice generator as the monthly schedule without changing the saved day.

myOhMyDesk.invoiceBeingProcessed: Your invoice request is being processed.
myOhMyDesk.onlyOwnerCanRequest: Only the Owner can request or renew a subscription.
myOhMyDesk.helpImproveDesc: Tell the team what is working, what is missing or what feels frustrating.
